title: 1.1 Application in Conservation of Natural Resources
description: Renewable and non-renewable resources, biodiversity, protected areas and conservation methods. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Renewable resource?
options: A protected area dedicated to the safety of wild animals
The sustainable use and protection of natural resources
A natural resource that forms far slower than it is used
A natural resource that can replenish itself over time
questions.correctAnswer: A natural resource that can replenish itself over time

questions.question: What is Non-renewable resource?
options: A protected area dedicated to the safety of wild animals
A species likely to become endangered in the near future
Protecting species within the ecosystems where they live
A natural resource that forms far slower than it is used
questions.correctAnswer: A natural resource that forms far slower than it is used

questions.question: What is Biodiversity?
options: Conserving threatened species outside their natural habitats
A store of seeds preserved to maintain plant genetic diversity
A facility that stores genetic material of crops and wildlife
The variety of life at genetic, species and ecosystem levels
questions.correctAnswer: The variety of life at genetic, species and ecosystem levels

questions.question: What is Conservation?
options: A natural resource that forms far slower than it is used
A protected area dedicated to the safety of wild animals
The sustainable use and protection of natural resources
Protecting species within the ecosystems where they live
questions.correctAnswer: The sustainable use and protection of natural resources

questions.question: What is Sustainable use?
options: Using a resource faster than it can naturally recover
A natural resource that can replenish itself over time
Using resources at a rate that allows natural renewal
The sustainable use and protection of natural resources
questions.correctAnswer: Using resources at a rate that allows natural renewal

The introduction of harmful substances into the environment
